cues.en: In this section, I've been focusing exclusively on the ideas and implementation of pre-training.
cues.zh: 這一節完全聚焦預訓練的概念與實作。

cues.en: The focus was entirely on understanding what pre-training means and how it works, and not really on optimizing the actual implementation.
cues.zh: 重點是理解意義、運作方式，沒有真正最佳化實作本身。

cues.en: In part, that's because training a useful base model takes so long, and there are already so many
cues.zh: 部分因為訓練有用的基礎模型太久，而且已有很多

cues.en: great pre-trained foundation models that are available for download that it's rarely necessary these days to pre-train a model from scratch.
cues.zh: 很棒的預訓練基礎模型能下載，如今很少需要從零開始。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I do want to mention a few ways that organizations try to decrease the computation time for training models.
cues.zh: 不過仍想提幾種組織縮短模型訓練計算時間的方法。

cues.en: Making the pre-training more efficient can mean the difference between many months versus many weeks,
cues.zh: 提高預訓練效率，可能把幾個月縮短為幾週，

cues.en: but that's still assumes that you have a lot of powerful GPU access.
cues.zh: 但仍假設能使用大量強大 GPU。

cues.en: So here are a few different ways that pre-training can go faster.
cues.zh: 以下幾種方式能加快。

cues.en: Computers, especially GPUs, are optimized for calculations on the order of a power of two.
cues.zh: 電腦，尤其 GPU，對 2 的冪次規模計算有最佳化。

cues.en: So it's actually better to have a batch size of 64 compared to 62.
cues.zh: 所以批次大小 64，其實比 62 更好。

cues.en: Now, I also must admit that I'm not super duper careful all the time when it comes to efficient data typing, except when it causes errors in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 也必須承認，我不會一直特別注意資料型別效率，除非造成 PyTorch 錯誤。

cues.en: But for example, you can make sure that integers are really coded as ints and not as floating point numbers, where you just don't use any of the numbers after the decimal point.
cues.zh: 例如可以確保整數真的以 int 編碼，而不是用浮點數，只是不使用小數部分。

cues.en: It is also possible to train models at a lower numerical precision, which can speed up training.
cues.zh: 也能用較低數值精度訓練，加快速度。

cues.en: Of course, the importance of GPUs cannot be understated.
cues.zh: GPU 的重要性，當然不容小覷。

cues.en: In this course we will use only one GPU, but you can really speed pre-training up by accessing lots
cues.zh: 課程只用一個，但使用很多，

cues.en: of GPUs like hundreds or thousands of GPUs, and training the models in parallel.
cues.zh: 例如幾百、幾千個 GPU，平行訓練，就能大幅加快。

cues.en: There are also GPUs that are custom designed for training large and deep deep learning networks, and
cues.zh: 也有專為大型、深層網路訓練設計的 GPU，

cues.en: once you're on a GPU, you can leverage larger batch sizes and using gradient accumulation.
cues.zh: 有了 GPU，就能用更大批次，以及梯度累積。

cues.en: You can also make learning go faster by having the right hyperparameters, including a learning rate scheduler, which means to adjust the learning rate in the beginning of training, and other little
cues.zh: 適當超參數也能加快學習，包括學習率排程器，在訓練開始時調整學習率，以及其他

cues.en: techniques like gradient normalization or gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 技巧，例如梯度正規化、梯度裁剪，

cues.en: Dynamic regularization, and so on.
cues.zh: 動態正則化等等。

cues.en: Now, these strategies don't necessarily help the calculations run faster, but they do help the model learn faster.
cues.zh: 不一定讓計算更快，但讓模型學得更快。

cues.en: So you don't need as many training epochs.
cues.zh: 因此不用那麼多訓練週期。

cues.en: PyTorch also has methods to make sure that the tensors in memory are not being segmented and stored
cues.zh: PyTorch 也有方法，確保記憶體裡的張量，不會分散儲存

cues.en: in different non-contiguous blocks, and that means that accessing those tensors will be faster.
cues.zh: 於不連續區塊，讓存取更快。

cues.en: And there are also combinations of algorithms and GPUs that are fused together, which means that the algorithm like.
cues.zh: 也有演算法與 GPU 結合、融合的做法，例如

cues.en: Attention, for example, is specifically designed to be maximally efficient.
cues.zh: 注意力演算法，專門設計成

cues.en: On a particular GPU chip.
cues.zh: 在特定 GPU 晶片上盡可能有效率。

cues.en: And you can also share weights across different parts of the network so that there are fewer parameters overall to train.
cues.zh: 還能讓網路不同部分共用權重，減少總訓練參數。

cues.en: This is already the case for GPU.
cues.zh: GPT 已經如此。

cues.en: For example, the embeddings and embeddings matrices.
cues.zh: 例如嵌入與反嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: The thing about training deep learning models is that if they take, let's say, several hours or maybe
cues.zh: 訓練深度學習模型，如果只是花幾小時，或在 GPU 上

cues.en: a day or two on a GPU to train, then you don't really have to worry about such detailed optimization points.
cues.zh: 花一、兩天，其實不太需要擔心這麼細的最佳化。

cues.en: But if you can shave off even a fraction of a second from one training iteration of a big LLM, then
cues.zh: 但大 LLM 每次訓練迭代，即使只省不到一秒，

cues.en: over the course of the entirety of pre-training, that fraction of a second times, you know, billions
cues.zh: 整個預訓練累積下來，乘以幾十億、

cues.en: or trillions of iterations might sum to a week or two weeks of saved training time.
cues.zh: 幾兆次迭代，也可能省下一、兩週。
